description: Phase 1 — ConditionalExpression (multi-branch case/when) end-to-end on the backend: contract + union/version bump, additive IR result_types, evaluator branch (D1 error-to-null inside conditionals only), three-backend codegen (Python nested ternary; R right-folded ifelse with NA guard; SAS IFC/IFN chosen from result_types per D2, else BackendCapabilityMissing), SDTM lower_plan result_types threading, the new expression-validation harness with expr_conditional_* codes wired into sdtm validate_plan, and conformance/unit/property tests. Implements design §3, §5, §7, §10(backend), §14 D1/D2/D3. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 except that both build on this contract + validation harness, so it MUST land first. NO Alembic migration (IR is JSONB). Follows plan.md items 1-7.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/typed-expression-expansion/design.md (§3, §5, §7, §14 D1/D2/D3) and plan.md items 1-7 FIRST. The free-text §13 option is REJECTED — never add a code/text field anywhere.

src/app/transformation/contracts.py: add ConditionalBranch(StrictModel){when: Expression; then: Expression} and ConditionalExpression(StrictModel){kind: Literal['conditional']; branches: tuple[ConditionalBranch, ...] = Field(min_length=1); otherwise: Expression}; add ConditionalExpression to the Expression Annotated union (keep forward-ref strings; call model_rebuild() only if Pydantic requires it). Add additive result_types: dict[str, Literal['character','numeric']] = Field(default_factory=dict) to IR DeriveNode. Change DataflowIR.operator_version to Literal['1.2.0'] = '1.2.0'; keep schema_version Literal['1.0.0'].

src/app/transformation/evaluator.py _value: add kind=='conditional' — iterate branches, first branch where cond=_value(when,row) is not None and bool(cond) returns _value(then,row); after loop return _value(otherwise,row). D1: swallow ZeroDivisionError/TypeError raised while evaluating when/then/otherwise INSIDE a conditional to null; a bare derive keeps raising preview_expression_type_invalid; do NOT swallow preview_column_unknown.

src/app/transformation/codegen.py: bump the three *_source banners and compiler= to 1.5.0 and CompiledProgram.compiler_version in service.py to 1.5.0. _py_expr: right-fold nested ternary innermost=otherwise with guard ((then) if (cond is not None and bool(cond)) else inner) and D1 null-guard on branch arithmetic. _r_expr: right-folded ifelse(cond & !is.na(cond), then, inner) with D1 normalizing per-branch arithmetic errors (Inf/NaN/NA) to NA. _sas_expr/sas_source: lower conditional via IFC(character)/IFN(numeric) chosen from the derive node's result_types[target] (D2); thread the per-assignment result type into the conditional lowerer; raise UnsupportedOperator when a conditional-valued assignment has no result_types entry (compile_dataflow maps it to BackendCapabilityMissing); D1 guard arithmetic to missing (.).

src/app/sdtm/service.py lower_plan: when building each derive IR dict, also build result_types by resolving each assignment target name against domains[node.target_domain].variables[*].name -> data_type (SdtmVariable.data_type). Include only targets that resolve to a declared variable; leave others absent.

Create src/app/transformation/expression_validation.py: a validator that walks every Expression and emits app.validation.contracts.ValidationIssue (common issue model, stable field_path). Codes: expr_conditional_empty (error), expr_conditional_result_type_mixed (warning: then/otherwise static literal types disagree character-vs-numeric), expr_conditional_branch_unreachable (warning: later branch whose when is a constant-true duplicate of an earlier guard). Do not put clinical rules in common. Wire src/app/sdtm/routes.py validate_plan to run this validator and return populated issues (preserve response shape).

Add tests/conformance/test_expression_conformance.py: harness that compiles a conditional-derive DataflowIR to Python and R, executes both via sys.executable/uv run python and Rscript into a tmp AURINARA_WORKSPACE, and compares outputs exactly (string/int/bool/date) and within node-declared tolerance (float). Include ITTFL (SAFFL=='Y' and RANDFL=='Y' -> 'Y' else null), null-when, short-circuit (unmatched div-by-zero -> null per D1), empty-string-vs-null, non-ASCII. Guard R asserts behind shutil.which('Rscript'). Assert SAS program generated when result_types present and BackendCapabilityMissing when absent (do not execute SAS).

Add tests/unit/test_transformation_conditional.py (evaluator selection/null-when/short-circuit/D1; codegen golden for _py_expr/_r_expr/_sas_expr incl. IFC vs IFN and BackendCapabilityMissing; contract round-trip; backward-compat old IR without result_types validates+lowers) and tests/unit/test_transformation_conditional_properties.py (Hypothesis: round-trip; selection vs Python oracle; null propagation).
acceptance_criteria: uv run pytest tests/unit tests/conformance -q passes (R conformance asserts active because Rscript is on PATH).

A conditional derive compiles to Python and R and produces identical normalized outputs for the ITTFL fixture; SAS compiles via IFC/IFN when result_types is present and raises BackendCapabilityMissing when absent.
expr_conditional_empty/_result_type_mixed/_branch_unreachable fire on the right malformed inputs and sdtm validate_plan returns them.
DataflowIR.operator_version == '1.2.0', schema_version unchanged, compiler banner == 1.5.0; an old IR payload WITHOUT result_types still validates and lowers (backward compat).
uv run ruff check ., uv run ruff format --check ., uv run mypy src all pass; NO Alembic migration added.
verification: uv run ruff check .; uv run ruff format --check .; uv run mypy src
findings:
FEAT-001 Phase 1 landed on branch feature/typed-expression-expansion in the worktree. Handoff facts for FEAT-002/FEAT-003:

CONTRACT (src/app/transformation/contracts.py): added `ConditionalBranch(StrictModel){when: Expression; then: Expression}` and `ConditionalExpression(StrictModel){kind: Literal['conditional']; branches: tuple[ConditionalBranch,...] min_length=1; otherwise: Expression}`, both added to the `Expression` Annotated discriminated union (no model_rebuild() was needed — Pydantic resolves the forward refs lazily; FEAT-002 can add FunctionCallExpression/ListLiteralExpression the same way). `DeriveNode` gained `result_types: dict[str, Literal['character','numeric']] = Field(default_factory=dict)` (IR node only; additive/backward-compatible — old IR without it validates). `DataflowIR.operator_version` is now `Literal['1.2.0']='1.2.0'`; `schema_version` unchanged at '1.0.0'.

EVALUATOR (src/app/transformation/evaluator.py): `_value` handles kind=='conditional' (iterate branches, first branch where `when` is not None and truthy returns `then`, else `otherwise`). D1 is implemented by catching ProblemException raised inside when/then/otherwise and returning None, EXCEPT code=='preview_column_unknown' which still propagates. A bare derive still raises preview_expression_type_invalid.

CODEGEN (src/app/transformation/codegen.py): banners + compiler= bumped to 1.5.0 in python_source/r_source/sas_source; service.py CompiledProgram.compiler_version='1.5.0'. Python: `_py_expr` right-folds nested ternary with a `guard(thunk)` preamble helper (catches ZeroDivisionError/TypeError/ValueError->None) and walrus `(_c := guard(lambda: WHEN))` for null/truthy test. R: `_r_expr` right-folds `ifelse((WHEN) & !is.na(WHEN), aur_norm(THEN), inner)` with an `aur_norm(x)` preamble helper that maps non-finite numerics to NA (D1). SAS: `_sas_expr(expression, result_type=None)` now takes an optional result_type; a conditional raises UnsupportedOperator('conditional_result_type_unknown') when result_type is not 'character'/'numeric' (compile_dataflow maps UnsupportedOperator->BackendCapabilityMissing), else right-folds IFC (character) / IFN (numeric). sas_source's derive branch passes `node.result_types.get(name)` per assignment.

SDTM LOWERING (src/app/sdtm/service.py lower_plan): the derive IR dict now includes `result_types` built by resolving each assignment target name against domains[node.target_domain].variables[*].name -> data_type (SdtmVariable.data_type is Literal['character','numeric']). Only targets that resolve to a declared variable are included; others are omitted (SAS then raises backend_capability_missing for those).

VALIDATION HARNESS (NEW src/app/transformation/expression_validation.py): public functions `validate_expression(expression, *, field_path, module, entity_type, entity_id=None) -> tuple[ValidationIssue,...]` and `validate_expressions(iterable[(field_path, expression)], *, module, entity_type, entity_id=None)`. Emits common app.validation.contracts.ValidationIssue with uuid5 ids (namespace f6b3c3d8-9c2a-4e4b-9a0c-2d6a1b7e5c40, key `{entity_id}:{code}:{field_path}`). Stable code constants exported: EXPR_CONDITIONAL_EMPTY (error), EXPR_CONDITIONAL_RESULT_TYPE_MIXED (warning), EXPR_CONDITIONAL_BRANCH_UNREACHABLE (warning). The internal `_walk` recurses conditional/unary/binary — FEAT-002 must EXTEND `_walk` to recurse into function arguments and list_literal and add expr_function_* / expr_list_literal_* codes here (do not create a second validator). FEAT-002 should also add arg-type logic reusing the `_literal_result_type` helper for D11. sdtm/routes.py::validate_plan now calls validate_expressions over authored plan expressions (filter/assert predicates + derive assignments via `_plan_expressions`), returns status 'invalid' when any error issue is present and `issues` as model_dump(mode='json') list, preserving the response's status/ir_fingerprint/issues shape.

TESTS: tests/unit/test_transformation_conditional.py (evaluator/codegen golden/contract/backward-compat/validation), tests/unit/test_transformation_conditional_properties.py (Hypothesis), tests/conformance/test_expression_conformance.py (Python+R executed and compared; SAS asserted generated-or-BackendCapabilityMissing; R guarded behind shutil.which('Rscript')). All 121 tests/unit+tests/conformance pass; ruff + mypy clean. NO Alembic migration added. NOTE: a PRE-EXISTING ruff-format drift in tests/integration/test_phase3_raw_sdtm.py exists on HEAD and was deliberately left untouched (unrelated to this feature). Frontend (plan.md step 8) and tests/contract OpenAPI regeneration were NOT part of FEAT-001 backend scope.
